representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands a comparison-panel for few (4) location-sensitive options with comparison required; implementation is a 4-column side-by-side criteria table (source/index.html:114, data of 4 rental candidates :121-130, 12 criteria with direction labels :132-149) plus a persistent geographic panel (aside :102-113) — shape, cardinality, density and location object all match.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Screenshot 1280x860 and 1440x900: the comparison table + weighted totals occupy roughly three-quarters of the initial screen; verdict pill '综合最优 C 云栖湾公寓 · 87 分' is fixed top-right (source/index.html:98, rendered in update() :292-293); subtitle states the job '调整权重，比较结果即时同屏更新' (:95).

time_to_understand.evidence: H1 + subtitle + verdict + rank badges (①–④, source/index.html:296-302) and footer '第N名 · 差X分' (:320) make what/where immediate in both screenshots; deduction: type.min_projected_size = fail (measurement-summary.json), consistent with 9px SVG ring labels (:212), 9px weight dots (:79) and 10-11px map/legend text (:38,:235-242), which slows reading of peripheral labels.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single static index.html with no routing or modes; both screenshots show all 4 candidates, all 12 criteria, weight steppers, 4 presets, verdict and map simultaneously at load; boot is synchronous with inlined data (source/index.html:120-130, :388-391), satisfying 'usable at load'.

context_loss.evidence: All interactions (weight steppers, presets, column/map focus) re-render in place via update() (source/index.html:286-337, :340-385); no modals or page exits; score row is explicitly labeled resident '加权综合得分 0–100 · 同屏驻留' (:266).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = header (4 preset buttons + verdict, :97-98), map aside with legend (:102-113), one table, footer row (:266-268) — each maps to the brief's stated need (high density, comparison required, geographic context); no nav chrome, tabs, or redundant panels in either screenshot.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast pass and a11y.focus_order pass, but a11y.target_size fail and type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json). Source corroborates: .wbtn stepper buttons are 18x18px (:75-76) below 24px minimum; 9px text (:79,:212). Additionally thead th (:50) and SVG map nodes (:232) are click-only (cursor:pointer, no tabindex/role/button), so column focus and candidate focus are unreachable by keyboard.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass and both screenshots are clean at 1280x860 and 1440x900. Rework implied by two failed checks (a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size). Minor cosmetic: ★ best-marker is anchored at the cell's right edge via td.best::before right:8px (:68-69), so at 1280 it renders beside the neighboring column's value (月租金 row: ★ appears next to 5800 while best 3900 is one column left); tfoot sticky bottom (:81) leaves dead whitespace below the table at both viewports.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏': the map (company marker 云枢科技园, 10/20/30min rings, Metro 3号线, candidates A–D with metro minutes, source/index.html:203-245) is permanently displayed left of the comparison table in both screenshots; hover/click links rows, columns and map nodes (:328-336, :357-364).

defects_observed: a11y.target_size = fail: 12 weight steppers rendered as 24 buttons of 18x18px (source/index.html:75-76), below the 24px minimum; also small map node hit areas (r=11 circles, :234)
type.min_projected_size = fail: 9px ring labels (:212) and 9px weight dots (:79), 10-11px candidate/legend text (:235-242, :38)

Keyboard gap: column-header focus (thead th, :50) and SVG candidate nodes (:232) have click handlers but no tabindex/role/keyboard equivalent — receipt a11y.focus_order pass covers only the tabbable buttons
★ best-value marker anchored at right cell edge (:68-69) visually detaches from its value and can be misread as marking the adjacent column at 1280 width (月租金 row in screenshots/1280x860.png)
missing_evidence: Sanitized receipt lists only check ids and pass/fail — which specific elements failed a11y.target_size / type.min_projected_size is inferred from source, not reported
Static screenshots show no interaction states (preset applied, weight changed, column/map focus), so in-place update behavior is verified only from source code, not visually
scores.overall_note: This package is a faithful realization of the decide x comparison-panel cell: four location-sensitive rental candidates compared side-by-side across 12 grouped criteria with adjustable weights, preset strategies, an instant verdict pill, and a persistent geographic panel that satisfies the acceptance seed ('地理语境与决策项同屏') at both viewports. The implementation is internally consistent — the min-max weighted scoring in source (index.html:163-183) reproduces the exact on-screen totals 56/28/87/39 and the footer rank/gap labels. Navigation cost and context loss are minimal (single page, all state updates in place, score row explicitly resident). The weaknesses are accessibility-grade rather than structural: the receipt fails a11y.target_size (18x18 weight steppers) and type.min_projected_size (9-11px text), and two prominent interactions (column-header focus, map-node focus) are pointer-only with no keyboard semantics, which is why accessibility (2) and frontend rework (3) drag down an otherwise top-band representation/salience profile. Per protocol, task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in blind review, and model-judged time_to_understand (4) is a proxy, not a human measurement.
